title: Remove terminal blank lines after generated-source stabilization
trigger_preconditions: diff hygiene identifies only terminal blank lines
failure_signature: After line-ending normalization, diff hygiene found one extra EOF blank line in the evidence-receipt builder and one in the shared runtime.
candidate_workaround: After source generation is stable, run an exact EOF whitespace check and repair only owner-scoped terminal blank lines.
recurrence_guard: Require zero-output diff hygiene after the final source patch and before each commit.
rollback: Keep the commit blocked if an EOF repair would alter executable content.
scope_boundary: Bounded owner-local operational recovery only; no scientific, professional, authority, production, security-complete, accessibility-complete, or independent-reproduction credit.
